definitions.explanation: Focusing all one's attention and effort on a single task or goal; dedicating oneself entirely to something.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{専念|せんねん}する。
{研究|けんきゅう}に{専念|せんねん}している。
examples.english: I am devoting myself to research.

examples.japanese: {育児|いくじ}に{専念|せんねん}するため{退職|たいしょく}した。
examples.english: I quit my job to focus on childcare.

notes:
{専念|せんねん}する means to devote oneself entirely to something, focusing all energy on a single pursuit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}に{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on work
- {研究|けんきゅう}に{専念|せんねん}する: to dedicate oneself to research
- {育児|いくじ}に{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on childcare
- {治療|ちりょう}に{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on treatment/recovery

USAGE NOTES:
- Takes に particle to mark what one is focusing on
- Often used when explaining career changes or life decisions
- Implies excluding other activities to focus on one thing
